style.css:
body {
    background-image: url('https://i.pinimg.com/736x/72/9a/8e/729a8e4a79dbbe4ad7196cbfd4fdac7e.jpg'); /* Your image URL */
    background-size: cover;  /* Ensure the background covers the full page */
    background-position: center center;  /* Center the background image */
    background-attachment: fixed;  /* Fix the background while scrolling */
    height: 100%;  /* Full height */
    margin: 0;  /* Remove any default margin */
    padding: 0;  /* Remove any default padding */
}
